Its extended handle lets you glide it smoothly across the face, neck, and body, and practitioners and users regularly report support for relaxation, circulation, and nervous system regulation. It's the same fork Chance uses in his own sessions, and a great entry point if you want to bring this work into your own daily routine.

fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Sine Waves, Yugas, and Human Progress", "body": "Lindsey Scharmyn said she was tutoring calculus when she began picturing the yugas as a sine wave instead of a circle. She argued that golden and dark ages implied progression, and that people had a role to play in the cycle rather than merely riding it. She said a suggestion from someone close to her to write the book she wished to read landed like a download. Later Chance read a passage from a book he planned to narrate next that questioned how ages are dated, and the talk turned to whether abstract cosmic calendars let people excuse their own lives."}, {"title": "Channeled Fiction and Daily Practice", "body": "Lindsey said she had never written fiction until three books arrived in her mind at once, and that scenes, characters and the quotes that open each part appeared as she wrote in twenty minute bursts around her teaching job. She said it matched how she worked in guidance sessions and that she had accepted the word channeling only in the past year. Chance praised the novel, said the audiobook ran 19 hours and 14 minutes, and argued that a small daily practice keeps the imagination open and builds momentum."}, {"title": "Qigong, Orgone, and Plasma", "body": "Chance said that returning to a correct daily qigong routine sharpened his sensitivity during tunings, and described the water in the body as closer to plasma than liquid. Gordy said he had placed orgone earth pipes between his owls and a nearby cell tower, and that the owls came back, and he added that energy work done with full bodied intention could be felt in the extremities. Chance later relayed Greg Little's argument from Origins of the Gods that plasma can self organize and replicate, and offered his own view that the spirit world was never somewhere else."}, {"title": "Lights, Mantis Beings, and Spirit Contact", "body": "Lindsey said she had seen lights in the sky throughout her life that seemed non-physical, could change shape, and were neither aliens, angels nor demons in her view. Gordy told of a meditation in which he sought out mantis beings and found himself in a bar where faces shifted into mantis forms. Lindsey replied that a being's appearance may come through the viewer's own lens, and described her own mantis meditation as a friendly tidy up of old mental habits. Other guests on the live show traded sightings of strange lights and shadow figures."}, {"title": "Oracle Draws, Guidestones, and Responsibility", "body": "Early in the show the speakers weighed the demolition of the Georgia Guidestones, with one voice saying their first thought was an act of God and others pointing to a frame by frame breakdown that looked like lightning. Later Lindsey drew the Devil card and read it as a call to stop scapegoating and notice temptation, while Chance drew the Seer from the Mystical Shaman Oracle and said the first rule of any spiritual path was to stop lying to yourself. Both tied the message to taking responsibility rather than waiting for rescue."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Our most mystically magic of friends Lindsey Scharmyn returns to Vibe Rant, this time to discuss her fictional novel series, Sine Curve of Aeons. The first book in this series, Phi'Telas, will soon be available in audiobook format, narrated by yours truly! In this chat, we'll learn more about Lindsey's life path, connection with spirits, the experience of writing, and more. Lindsey is also the intrepid host of Rogue Ways, a podcast you likely already know and love!
fields.Quotes JSON: [{"text": "I got some of that orgone from Mitch because my owls were gone. They had left when they turned on that 5G tower. I put some of those orgone earth pipes in between them and that tower and they came back.", "author": "Gordan Hamil", "portrait": ""}, {"text": "Once you start to understand that and you actually do the actual energy movements with that intention, that full bodied intention, you start to feel it in your extremities. You know, you start to feel the power.", "author": "Gordan Hamil", "portrait": ""}, {"text": "I don't buy that. I think that we have a role to play in it. And I don't think that it's just this circle. I think it's this sine wave, and that indicates progression, actually, whether we go through golden ages and dark ages or not. Something is shifting as we go, we are shifting as we go.", "author": "Lindsey Scharmyn", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/266fc9f2-e364-4218-b441-a558779d7c0c/LINDSAY-SCHARMYN.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "There's this amazing theme of the story that carries through the whole time, of the importance of following the path that you know is meant for you, that your soul screams at you that you must do, and how you have no real understanding what ripples or importance you following that path may put out into the world.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "I feel when people are like, you wrote this book, and even more so with the more recent books I've written, I'm like, no, I didn't. I typed them out and formatted them and published them, but something else is doing all that. I'm just really good at following directions.", "author": "Lindsey Scharmyn", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/266fc9f2-e364-4218-b441-a558779d7c0c/LINDSAY-SCHARMYN.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "You cannot underestimate the power of a daily practice, even if it is a small practice, because you are building momentum with each of those 20 minute sections. If you only had time in your daily life for 20 minutes of drawing or 20 minutes of typing, or whatever the case may be, and you do that, imagine how many more minutes of accumulated progress you will have.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "And all those quotes are saying the same thing, right? They're saying, if you want to change the world, you have to change yourself. If you want to do good, like your angels are going to be stoked about that.", "author": "Lindsey Scharmyn", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/266fc9f2-e364-4218-b441-a558779d7c0c/LINDSAY-SCHARMYN.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "And they quickly showed me that they were not that at all and that they're in fact non-physical, non-material, that they communicate psychically, and that they're energetic beings or interdimensional beings if you want to call them that, and that they can appear however they want to appear, but most often appear as lights, especially at night in the sky.", "author": "Lindsey Scharmyn", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/266fc9f2-e364-4218-b441-a558779d7c0c/LINDSAY-SCHARMYN.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "I think that this is the spirit world, we never left, there's nowhere else that you can go. The physical world is just one part of the frequency bandwidth of the infinite spirit. And we're in the spirit world right now, there isn't a separation between there and here, other than conceptually. Division is mental.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "I actually love this card though because it's far less scary and demonic than we might think. The devil card is actually more about temptation than anything else. You know, so the devil is actually this very high level spiritual being. He's got his little third eye open here.", "author": "Lindsey Scharmyn", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/266fc9f2-e364-4218-b441-a558779d7c0c/LINDSAY-SCHARMYN.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Basically the first rule of any initiation into a true spiritual path or the path of enlightenment is the first rule of fight club, right? The first rule of your initiation and your path as an adept is stop lying to yourself. And that rule will always be rule number one.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "You have to surrender to whatever you could see of that stuff as etheric spiritual light, like source, whatever, and you have to let it come in. And you maybe even have to tell it where to go. And then, you know, now you're healing yourself. But people have an easier time often having faith in someone else than they do in themselves.", "author": "Lindsey Scharmyn", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/266fc9f2-e364-4218-b441-a558779d7c0c/LINDSAY-SCHARMYN.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "That's actually one of my main points that I always want people to realize and remember, 100% of people are amazing and beautiful and unique.", "author": "Lindsey Scharmyn", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/266fc9f2-e364-4218-b441-a558779d7c0c/LINDSAY-SCHARMYN.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}]
